description: Defines data models for quizzes including the QuizCatalog and QuizQuestion classes with relevant properties and methods.

classes.name: QuizCatalog
classes.description: Represents a full quiz with multiple questions and associated metadata.

classes.name: QuizQuestion
classes.description: Models a single multiple-choice question with options, correct answer, and optional explanation.

methods.name: questionCount
methods.description: Returns the number of questions in the quiz.

methods.name: isCorrect
methods.description: Checks if a given option index matches the correct answer index.
